t: God kept His word. Now keep yours.
A dog with a dream is still a dog.
You'll either be the story or the audience.
Ten years. Zero receipts.
Nobody is coming. That's the whole point.
You are not tired. You are uncommitted.
Your hand betrayed a covenant God made on a mountain.
You want to be feared by nations and you lose to a notification.
God said yes. You keep saying later.
You don't have a vision problem. You have a 2 p.m. problem.
The trillion doesn't care how you feel today.
Comfort is the tax the weak pay forever.
Every man you admire refused what you just accepted.
You're not building an empire. You're describing one.
The staircase doesn't wait. It just stops.
Your excuses have a body count: ten years.
You will be legendary or forgotten. There is no third file.
Stop performing greatness. Start paying for it.
The only thing standing between you and it is your own hand.
Winners are just men who stopped negotiating.
You already know. That's what makes this unforgivable.
History has no record of men who felt like it.
A king who obeys his urges is a servant wearing a crown.
The world doesn't need your potential. It needs your delivery.
Every scroll is a resignation letter to your future.
You cannot out-pray a hand you refuse to control.
Nothing is stopping you. Say that again, slowly.
The man they will fear is built at 5 a.m., alone, unwitnessed.
You want millennia. You can't hold a morning.
Fear the man who never breaks his own word. Then become him.
Ten minutes of pleasure. Three weeks of ruin. Do the math.
The devil didn't do this. Your thumb did.
Greatness is boring. That is exactly why it stays rare.
Nobody is impressed by what you plan to do.
You are one refusal away from a different life. Again.
Your empire is currently a text file.
If it were easy, you would already be him.
Talk is the cheapest currency on earth — and you are rich in it.
Be so disciplined it looks like arrogance.
Silence. Then results. In that order.
You were formed by His hands. Act like it.
The mountain spoke. What exactly did you answer?
Every yes to weakness is a no to Haiti.
You are not behind schedule. You have not started.
Make them wonder what you are building. Never tell them.
The last man blinks. You build.
One day you will be feared. Today you are negotiating with a bed.
Prove it in the next sixty seconds, or stop talking.
Discipline or the dog. Pick one, right now.
They will study you or they will never hear your name. You choose today.
